layers.title: Built-up 1985-2023
layers.description: The first year each 30 m cell became built-up, from 1985 to 2023. Colour runs dark purple (built in or before 1985) through green to yellow (built in 2023); anywhere still not built by 2023 is transparent. Two sources are stitched together: 1985-2015 comes from WSF Evolution, which reads Landsat satellite images and measures settled area, and 2017-2023 comes from Google Open Buildings, which measures buildings themselves, counting a cell as built once buildings cover at least 15% of it in two years running. Because the two halves measure slightly different things, compare years within one era rather than across the 2015/16 join. Once a cell is marked built it stays built, so demolition and clearance do not show. There is no 2016 class: built-up that Google sees in 2016 but WSF missed (53.1 sq km, mostly dense low-rise) is dated 2015, which makes the 2015 increment (64.3 sq km) larger than that year's real growth (11.2 sq km).
layers.source_name: DLR WSF Evolution + Google Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal
layers.attribution: WSF Evolution (DLR, CC-BY 4.0); Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal (Google, CC-BY 4.0)

layers.title: Building Height 2023
layers.description: Estimated building height in 2023, at about 4 m, in bands from 0-3 m (pale yellow) to 40 m and over (dark red). The heights are model estimates from satellite imagery with roughly metre-level error, and they are least reliable for small, low buildings. Places with no building in 2023 are transparent.
layers.attribution: WSF Evolution (DLR, CC-BY 4.0); Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal (Google, CC-BY 4.0)

layers.title: Built-up 1985-2023 (year-encoded)
layers.description: Data companion to Built-up 1985-2023: lossless PNG tiles whose red channel encodes the first built-up year per cell. Not for direct display.
layers.source_name: DLR WSF Evolution + Google Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal
layers.attribution: WSF Evolution (DLR, CC-BY 4.0); Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal (Google, CC-BY 4.0)
layers.decode: alpha 0 = never built; R >= 5 -> year = R + 1980 (5 = 1985 or earlier ... 43 = 2023); no 2016 value (cells Open Buildings saw in 2016 that WSF missed are folded into 2015); G and B unused

layers.title: Building Height 2023 (height-encoded)
layers.description: Data companion to Building Height 2023: lossless PNG tiles whose red and green channels encode building height in decimetres. Not for direct display.
layers.attribution: WSF Evolution (DLR, CC-BY 4.0); Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal (Google, CC-BY 4.0)
layers.decode: height_dm = R*256 + G; height_m = height_dm/10; alpha 0 = no building
